pairs: Blessed are they whose iniquities have been forgiven
and whose sins have been covered.
Beatus vir cui non imputavit Dominus peccatum,
Blessed is the man to whom the Lord has not imputed sin,
nec est in spiritu ejus dolus.
and in whose spirit there is no deceit.
while still I cried out all day long.
Quoniam die ac nocte gravata est super me manus tua,
For, day and night, your hand was heavy upon me.
I have been converted in my anguish,
while still the thorn is piercing.
I have acknowledged my offense to you,
and I have not concealed my injustice.
Confitebor adversum me injustitiam meam Domino;
“I will confess against myself, my injustice to the Lord,”
et tu remisisti impietatem peccati mei.
and you forgave the impiety of my sin.
Pro hac orabit ad te omnis sanctus in tempore opportuno.
For this, everyone who is holy will pray to you in due time.
Yet truly, in a flood of many waters,
they will not draw near to him.
Tu es refugium meum a tribulatione quæ circumdedit me;
You are my refuge from the tribulation that has surrounded me.
rescue me from those who are surrounding me.
et instruam te in via hac qua gradieris;
and I will instruct you in this way, in which you will walk.
I will fix my eyes upon you.
Nolite fieri sicut equus et mulus,
Do not become like the horse and the mule,
In camo et freno maxillas eorum constringe,
Their jaws are constrained with bit and bridle,
so as not to draw near to you.
Many are the scourges of the sinner,
sperantem autem in Domino misericordia circumdabit.
but mercy will surround him that hopes in the Lord.
